name: Lost Cities
summary: Two-player card game where players build color-coded expeditions in increasing order to maximize points.
rules_text: Place board with 5 color discard spaces between players. Shuffle 60 cards (9 numbers 2-10 and 3 wagers per color). Deal 8 cards to each player; remaining cards form face-down draw pile. Oldest player starts; turns alternate. On your turn you must first play one card from hand, then draw one. To play to your expeditions: start or extend a column of that color on your side; numbers must be strictly increasing within a column; wager cards can only be played before any number card in that column, multiple allowed. To discard: place a card face-up on its color discard pile, only top visible. Then draw: take top card of draw pile or top card of any discard pile, but not the card you just discarded. Game ends immediately when last card is drawn from draw pile. Score each color: sum numbers, subtract 20 if column exists, multiply result by 1 plus number of wagers (x2,x3,x4), add 20 bonus if column has 8+ cards. No column scores 0. Highest total after three rounds wins.
rating_reason: Two-player card game, hidden hands, sequential choice, arithmetic scoring.
